slots.bio: 152 km of gentle cycling along an old railway line through tunnels, viaducts and gold-rush villages.
A charming gold-rush town of stone cottages and old hotels beneath the Clyde Dam, at the start of the Rail Trail.
A vivid blue lake filling an old gold-sluicing pit, ringed by eroded white cliffs beside a tiny historic village.
Old Cromwell rebuilt stone by stone on the shore of Lake Dunstan after the town was flooded by the Clyde Dam.
